ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the horizontal axis is rainfall amount (millimeters), and the vertical axis is plant interception amount; there are two curves in the figure representing different rainfall durations, labeled 25 hours and 50 hours respectively. The 50-hour curve is overall above the 25-hour curve. Then reason: make a vertical comparison at the same rainfall amount position, for example, at the same rainfall amount, the plant interception amount corresponding to 50 hours is higher than that of 25 hours, indicating that the longer the rainfall duration, the greater the total amount of plant interception. Therefore, when the total amount of plant interception is relatively large, the rainfall duration should be longer.
